bull.probability_evidence: Bull case: ROIC rose from 20.7% to 43.5% TTM, FCF margin from 11.4% to 22.6%, and net debt/EBITDA fell to 1.39x; an 8.05% FCF yield funds a 5.53% annual share-count reduction and a 16% dividend raise with no re-rating needed; P/E is a 25% discount to peers despite structurally higher margins; and the macro overlay ties the 3-month sell-off to stock-specific sentiment rather than rates or credit, so a solid Nov 5 print could reverse it (research/TPR/2026-10-08-evaluation.md Bull case; research/TPR/2026-10-08-macro.md Assessment).

target_price_12m.cite: evaluation.md Decision block scenarios.bull.target_price_12m: margins hold and P/FCF re-rates from 12.4x to its 5y max of 16.5x on steady TTM FCF as the sentiment-driven sell-off reverses

target_band.cite: Half the spread of the bull target priced on P/FCF (16.5x, 5y max, flat FCF/share -> $150.92, factsheet-2026-10-08.md Valuation table) vs EV/EBITDA (16.0x, 5y max, on flat EBITDA/share and net debt/share since margins hold -> $149.15, derived from EV/EBITDA 12.5x and net debt/EBITDA 1.39x, Valuation and Quality tables); P/E's 5y max (98.8x) is excluded as distorted by FY2025's depressed 2.6% net margin (factsheet Quality table), not a valuation signal; spread $1.77 / 2 / $150.9 target = 0.59%

base.probability_evidence: Base is the modal/status-quo outcome: valuation is cheap only on P/E (7th percentile of 5y range), while EV/EBITDA (12.5x) sits above its 5y median (9.3x) and in line with peers, and P/FCF (12.4x) is at its 5y median, so quality is excellent but the stock is fairly rather than mispriced -- consistent with conviction 3 (AVOID) and no clear catalyst before the Nov 5 print (evaluation.md Bear case and Decision rationale).

target_price_12m.cite: evaluation.md Decision block scenarios.base.target_price_12m: P/FCF stays near its 5y median of 12.5x on flat TTM FCF, with buybacks (-5.53% shares YoY) offsetting no re-rating

target_band.cite: Base case holds each anchor's CURRENT multiple flat (P/E 15.6x, EV/EBITDA 12.5x, P/FCF 12.4x, factsheet-2026-10-08.md Valuation table) and grows per-share by the -5.53% YoY buyback factor (factsheet Other table) -- the P/E, EV/EBITDA and P/FCF implied prices all converge at ~$120.06 (to the cent), so there is no cross-anchor disagreement in this scenario

bear.probability_evidence: Bear case: EV/EBITDA (12.5x) is already above its 5y median (9.3x) and in line with peers, not cheap; margins are at 5y peaks (gross 76.6%, operating 23.3%) with Coach at 86.4% of sales, so any promotional creep flows straight to earnings; the stock already fell 22.5% in 3 months, lagged SPY by 26.4pp, and short interest (8.09%, +3.2% vs prior month) signals informed sellers expect a weaker Nov 5 print (evaluation.md Bear case; factsheet-2026-10-08.md Price and News & sentiment tables).

target_price_12m.cite: evaluation.md Decision block scenarios.bear.target_price_12m: Coach promotional pressure from peak margins (operating margin 23.3%) compresses P/FCF to its 5y min of 8.6x

target_band.cite: Bear case compresses each anchor's multiple to its own 5y minimum on flat per-share fundamentals (the promotional-pressure shock hits the multiple, not FCF/EBITDA/EPS): P/FCF 5y min 8.6x -> $78.66 (the evaluator's target); EV/EBITDA 5y min 7.3x -> $60.33 (derived from EV/EBITDA 12.5x and net debt/EBITDA 1.39x); P/E 5y min 9.1x -> $66.16 (factsheet-2026-10-08.md Valuation table); spread $18.33 ($78.66-$60.33) / 2 / $78.7 target = 11.6%
